## Members in this source section

## Declarations and implementations

```plato

// Spatial domain-warped noise: the sample point is displaced by a warp noise
// of WarpFrequency scaled by WarpStrength, applied Iterations times, before
// evaluating the Basis noise. Produces marbled, fluid-like patterns.
type DomainWarpNoise3D
    implements IValue, IScalarField3D
{
    Basis: NoiseBasis;
    Seed: Integer;
    Frequency: Number;
    WarpStrength: Number;
    WarpFrequency: Number;
    Iterations: Integer;
}

// Planar curl noise: the 90-degree rotation of the gradient of a smooth
// scalar potential, yielding a divergence-free vector field. Ideal for
// advecting particles without sources or sinks
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Curl_(mathematics)).
type CurlNoise2D
    implements IValue, IVectorField2D
{
    Seed: Integer;
    Frequency: Number;
}

// Spatial curl noise: the curl of a smooth vector potential, yielding a
// divergence-free vector field. Ideal for incompressible, swirling motion
// of particles, smoke, and hair
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Curl_(mathematics)).
type CurlNoise3D
    implements IValue, IVectorField3D
{
    Seed: Integer;
    Frequency: Number;
}
```
